notes.title: BETA ENDING / 1.0 IS HERE!
notes.content:
[h2]OPEN BETA CLOSING ITS DOORS[/h2]

But no fear, the 1.0 release is already here!

We'll be deactivating access to the beta, however your progress will carry over to the main game. To transition simply download the full free version of the game and you'll be able to access all of your saves just as you did in the beta. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653970/Jigsaw_Puzzle_Dreams/

Just note that while Room Customization saves will also carry over, there may be some colors you chose that don't look quite the same. We've updated many aspects of this feature, so there may be some differences between beta and 1.0 versions. 


Many thanks to everyone whos participated in the beta! All of your feedback has been appreciated, and the screenshots and puzzle art you've all been creating has been absolutely fantastic to see ːLIS_pixel_heartː

We haven't had a chance to do another Community Spotlight post in a while, but I hope to remedy that soon :)


See you on the other side!

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Music Player added!
[*] 200+ songs added ːpartydiskː
[*] New option to play on floor without table
[*] Added shortcut to reset preview image to the shelf
[*] Disconnect piece button now also works as grab piece if nothing to disconnect
[*] Autosaves now occur also when entering menu
[*] ESC key now toggles menu
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed in game buttons not showing after loading puzzle
[*] Fixed Date/Time not showing on saves correctly
[*] Fixed issue with Rotating left not always correct amount
[*] Fixed issues with menu and highlighted pieces
[*] Fixed camera issue with WASD movement and rotating at the same time
[/list]
